name: whim
description: Turn an idea, a story or lyrics into a real sung song with cover art, played right in the chat.

interface.shortDescription: Turn any idea into a song
interface.longDescription:
Whim turns an idea, a story or lyrics into a real sung song, with music and its own cover art.

Tell ChatGPT what the song is about, or ask it to write the lyrics, and say "make it a real song". Add a sound if you have one in mind, like dreamy 80s synth-pop, late-night jazz or a big pop chorus. The song plays right in the chat.

Want to send it? Tap "Get a link to share" and your song gets its own page on onwhim.app.

Try a birthday song for a friend, a diss track for the dry texter, or what happened in your group chat last night.

Each person can make one song here. Full songs and more are coming in the Whim iPhone app, and you can join early access from the player.
capabilities: Turn an idea or a story into a sung song
Sing lyrics you or ChatGPT wrote
Pick a sound or describe one
Play the song right in the chat
Get a link to share the song with friends
defaultPrompt: Turn what happened in my group chat into a song
Make a birthday song for my best friend
Sing the lyrics I just wrote

positive.description: A song from an idea. Run cases 1 to 5 in order on one account: for this review each account can make 4 songs (1 in production).
positive.prompt: Make me a song about my cat who ignores me every morning
positive.expected_behavior: The Whim player appears at once and shows the song being made. In about a minute it shows cover art and the title and plays a short sung song. It also offers an optional email field for early access to the Whim app.

positive.description: ChatGPT writes lyrics, then Whim sings them
positive.prompt: Write me a short breakup song about my ex who still watches all my stories, and make it a real song I can listen to
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the lyrics in the chat, then calls make_song with them. The player sings those lyrics.

positive.description: A story turned into a song
positive.prompt: My group chat spent 3 hours arguing whether pineapple belongs on pizza. Turn it into a song
positive.expected_behavior: make_song is called with a one-sentence summary and lyrics (not a pasted chat). The player plays a song about the pizza argument.

positive.description: A gift song with a chosen sound
positive.prompt: Write a birthday song for my sister Maya in 80s synth-pop
positive.expected_behavior: make_song is called with a synth-pop sound. The player plays a synth-pop song about Maya's birthday.

positive.description: The song limit: this is the fifth request on the same account, so no new song is made. This is the expected result.
positive.prompt: Make another song about my dog
positive.expected_behavior: No new song is made. The player shows the person's song again with a line saying they've made their one song here, and offers early access to the Whim app.

negative.prompt: What are the lyrics to Bohemian Rhapsody?
Recommend some upbeat songs for a road trip playlist
Just write me lyrics for a rap verse about Mondays, text only

publication.release_notes: First release: turn an idea, a story or lyrics into a sung song with cover art, play it in the chat, and get a link to share it.
